description: Freshchat knowledge base template for local service businesses. Replace all {{CLIENT_*}} placeholders with actual business data before deploying.

qa_pairs.question: What services do you offer?
qa_pairs.answer: {{CLIENT_NAME}} offers a full range of {{CLIENT_BUSINESS_TYPE}} services, including {{CLIENT_SERVICE_LIST}}. Whether you need routine maintenance, repairs, or a full installation, our experienced team is ready to help. Contact us to discuss your specific needs.

qa_pairs.question: What areas do you serve?
qa_pairs.answer: We proudly serve {{CLIENT_SERVICE_AREA}} and the surrounding communities, including {{CLIENT_ADDITIONAL_CITIES}}. If you are unsure whether we cover your location, please call us at {{CLIENT_PHONE}} or enter your zip code on our website at {{CLIENT_WEBSITE}}.

qa_pairs.question: What are your hours of operation?
qa_pairs.answer: Our regular business hours are {{CLIENT_BUSINESS_HOURS}}. Our office is open {{CLIENT_OFFICE_DAYS}} from {{CLIENT_OFFICE_OPEN}} to {{CLIENT_OFFICE_CLOSE}}. For after-hours emergencies, please call {{CLIENT_EMERGENCY_PHONE}} — we have technicians on call {{CLIENT_EMERGENCY_AVAILABILITY}}.

qa_pairs.question: How do I book an appointment?
qa_pairs.answer: Booking an appointment with {{CLIENT_NAME}} is easy! You can: (1) Call us at {{CLIENT_PHONE}} to speak with a team member, (2) Book online 24/7 at {{CLIENT_BOOKING_URL}}, or (3) Send us an email at {{CLIENT_EMAIL}}. We will confirm your appointment within {{CLIENT_BOOKING_CONFIRMATION_TIME}} and send a reminder the day before your scheduled visit.

qa_pairs.question: How much do your services cost?
qa_pairs.answer: Our pricing varies based on the scope of work, materials needed, and your location. Basic {{CLIENT_BUSINESS_TYPE}} services typically start at {{CLIENT_STARTING_PRICE}}. We provide transparent, upfront pricing before any work begins — no hidden fees. For an accurate quote tailored to your project, please request a free estimate at {{CLIENT_WEBSITE}} or call {{CLIENT_PHONE}}.

qa_pairs.question: Do you offer free estimates?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes! {{CLIENT_NAME}} offers free, no-obligation estimates for all {{CLIENT_BUSINESS_TYPE}} services. One of our certified technicians will assess your needs and provide a detailed written quote at no charge. To schedule your free estimate, visit {{CLIENT_WEBSITE}} or call us at {{CLIENT_PHONE}} during business hours.

qa_pairs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
qa_pairs.answer: We accept a variety of payment methods for your convenience, including {{CLIENT_PAYMENT_METHODS}}. Payment is due upon completion of service unless other arrangements have been made in advance. For larger projects, we may require a deposit. If you have questions about payment options, please ask our team when scheduling your appointment.

qa_pairs.question: How quickly can you respond to a service call?
qa_pairs.answer: For standard service calls, we typically respond within {{CLIENT_STANDARD_RESPONSE_TIME}}. For urgent or emergency situations, our response time is {{CLIENT_EMERGENCY_RESPONSE_TIME}}. We understand your time is valuable and strive to arrive within the scheduled window. You will receive a call or text when our technician is on the way.

qa_pairs.question: What should I expect on a first visit?
qa_pairs.answer: On your first visit with {{CLIENT_NAME}}, a uniformed, background-checked technician will arrive within the scheduled window. They will: (1) Introduce themselves and present their ID, (2) Assess your {{CLIENT_BUSINESS_TYPE}} needs, (3) Explain the recommended work and provide a written quote, and (4) Begin work only after you approve the estimate. We respect your home — technicians use {{CLIENT_PROTECTIVE_MEASURES}} to keep your space clean.

qa_pairs.question: Do you offer emergency services?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, {{CLIENT_NAME}} provides emergency {{CLIENT_BUSINESS_TYPE}} services {{CLIENT_EMERGENCY_AVAILABILITY}}. If you are experiencing an urgent issue, call our emergency line at {{CLIENT_EMERGENCY_PHONE}}. Emergency service rates may apply outside of standard business hours. Do not hesitate to call — our team is here to help when you need it most.

qa_pairs.question: What makes you different from competitors?
qa_pairs.answer: {{CLIENT_NAME}} stands out because of our {{CLIENT_KEY_DIFFERENTIATORS}}. We have been serving {{CLIENT_SERVICE_AREA}} for {{CLIENT_YEARS_IN_BUSINESS}} years, building our reputation on quality workmanship, honest pricing, and exceptional customer service. We are proud of our {{CLIENT_REVIEW_RATING}}-star average rating across {{CLIENT_REVIEW_PLATFORMS}}. Our team is {{CLIENT_CERTIFICATIONS_SUMMARY}}, ensuring every job meets the highest standards.

qa_pairs.question: Are you licensed and insured?
qa_pairs.answer: Absolutely. {{CLIENT_NAME}} is fully licensed in {{CLIENT_STATE_OR_REGION}} (License #{{CLIENT_LICENSE_NUMBER}}) and carries comprehensive general liability insurance (up to {{CLIENT_INSURANCE_COVERAGE}}) as well as workers compensation coverage for all employees. We are happy to provide proof of insurance upon request before any work begins.

qa_pairs.question: Do you offer warranties or guarantees?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes! All work performed by {{CLIENT_NAME}} is backed by our {{CLIENT_WORKMANSHIP_WARRANTY}} workmanship guarantee. In addition, parts and equipment we install carry manufacturer warranties of {{CLIENT_PARTS_WARRANTY}}. If you experience any issue related to our work within the warranty period, we will return and make it right at no additional cost.

qa_pairs.question: How do I leave a review?
qa_pairs.answer: We truly appreciate your feedback! You can leave a review for {{CLIENT_NAME}} on {{CLIENT_REVIEW_PLATFORMS}}. Your review helps other neighbors find trustworthy {{CLIENT_BUSINESS_TYPE}} services and motivates our team to keep delivering great work. If you had an issue with your service, please contact us directly at {{CLIENT_EMAIL}} or {{CLIENT_PHONE}} — we want the opportunity to make it right.

qa_pairs.question: What is your cancellation policy?
qa_pairs.answer: We understand that schedules change. To cancel or reschedule your appointment, please notify us at least {{CLIENT_CANCELLATION_NOTICE_HOURS}} hours in advance by calling {{CLIENT_PHONE}} or emailing {{CLIENT_EMAIL}}. Cancellations made with less than {{CLIENT_CANCELLATION_NOTICE_HOURS}} hours notice may be subject to a {{CLIENT_CANCELLATION_FEE}} cancellation fee. Emergency situations are handled on a case-by-case basis.

qa_pairs.question: Do you offer financing or payment plans?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, {{CLIENT_NAME}} offers flexible financing options through {{CLIENT_FINANCING_PARTNER}} for qualifying customers. Plans include {{CLIENT_FINANCING_TERMS}}. Applying takes only a few minutes and does not affect your credit score initially. Ask your technician about financing during your estimate, or visit {{CLIENT_FINANCING_URL}} to learn more and apply.

qa_pairs.question: How do I get a quote?
qa_pairs.answer: Getting a quote from {{CLIENT_NAME}} is simple and free. You can: (1) Fill out the quote request form at {{CLIENT_QUOTE_URL}}, (2) Call us at {{CLIENT_PHONE}} and describe your project, or (3) Send photos and a description to {{CLIENT_EMAIL}}. For most projects, we provide a ballpark estimate within {{CLIENT_QUOTE_TURNAROUND}} and schedule a free on-site assessment to finalize pricing.

qa_pairs.question: What brands or products do you use?
qa_pairs.answer: {{CLIENT_NAME}} works with industry-leading brands including {{CLIENT_PREFERRED_BRANDS}}. We source materials from trusted suppliers to ensure durability, performance, and value. In some cases, we can work with customer-supplied materials — speak with our team about compatibility and warranty implications. We will always recommend the best product for your specific situation and budget.

qa_pairs.question: Do you offer maintenance contracts or service plans?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes! {{CLIENT_NAME}} offers {{CLIENT_MAINTENANCE_PLAN_NAME}}, our ongoing maintenance plan designed to keep your {{CLIENT_BUSINESS_TYPE}} systems in peak condition. Plan benefits include {{CLIENT_MAINTENANCE_PLAN_BENEFITS}}. Members also receive {{CLIENT_MAINTENANCE_PLAN_DISCOUNT}} off all service calls and priority scheduling. Plans start at {{CLIENT_MAINTENANCE_PLAN_PRICE}} per {{CLIENT_MAINTENANCE_PLAN_PERIOD}}. Contact us at {{CLIENT_PHONE}} to enroll.

qa_pairs.question: How do I contact you?
qa_pairs.answer: You can reach {{CLIENT_NAME}} through any of the following channels: Phone: {{CLIENT_PHONE}} | Emergency Line: {{CLIENT_EMERGENCY_PHONE}} | Email: {{CLIENT_EMAIL}} | Website: {{CLIENT_WEBSITE}} | Online Chat: Available on our website during business hours | Social Media: {{CLIENT_SOCIAL_MEDIA_HANDLES}}. Our office hours are {{CLIENT_BUSINESS_HOURS}}. For after-hours emergencies, call {{CLIENT_EMERGENCY_PHONE}}.

placeholder_reference.CLIENT_BUSINESS_TYPE: Type of service (e.g., plumbing, HVAC, electrical)
placeholder_reference.CLIENT_SERVICE_LIST: Comma-separated list of specific services offered
placeholder_reference.CLIENT_ADDITIONAL_CITIES: Comma-separated list of additional cities or towns served
placeholder_reference.CLIENT_OFFICE_DAYS: Days office is open (e.g., Monday through Friday)
placeholder_reference.CLIENT_EMERGENCY_AVAILABILITY: When emergency service is available (e.g., 24/7, 365 days a year)
placeholder_reference.CLIENT_BOOKING_CONFIRMATION_TIME: How soon booking confirmations are sent (e.g., 1 business hour)
placeholder_reference.CLIENT_STARTING_PRICE: Lowest typical starting price for basic services (e.g., $89)
placeholder_reference.CLIENT_PAYMENT_METHODS: Accepted payment types (e.g., Visa, Mastercard, cash, check, Zelle)
placeholder_reference.CLIENT_PROTECTIVE_MEASURES: Steps taken to protect home (e.g., shoe covers and drop cloths)
placeholder_reference.CLIENT_KEY_DIFFERENTIATORS: What sets the business apart (e.g., same-day service, flat-rate pricing)
placeholder_reference.CLIENT_YEARS_IN_BUSINESS: Number of years the company has been operating
placeholder_reference.CLIENT_REVIEW_PLATFORMS: Review sites used (e.g., Google, Yelp, Facebook)
placeholder_reference.CLIENT_PARTS_WARRANTY: Parts/equipment warranty duration (e.g., up to 10 years)
placeholder_reference.CLIENT_FINANCING_PARTNER: Financing company name (e.g., GreenSky, Service Finance)
placeholder_reference.CLIENT_FINANCING_TERMS: Financing plan details (e.g., 0% interest for 18 months)
placeholder_reference.CLIENT_QUOTE_TURNAROUND: Time to receive initial quote estimate (e.g., same day)
placeholder_reference.CLIENT_PREFERRED_BRANDS: Brands used (e.g., Trane, Rheem, Moen, Kohler)
placeholder_reference.CLIENT_MAINTENANCE_PLAN_NAME: Name of the maintenance plan (e.g., Premier Care Plan)
placeholder_reference.CLIENT_MAINTENANCE_PLAN_BENEFITS: What the plan includes (e.g., annual tune-up, priority scheduling, 10% discount)
placeholder_reference.CLIENT_CERTIFICATIONS_SUMMARY: Key certifications or credentials (e.g., NATE-certified and EPA-licensed)
placeholder_reference.CLIENT_SOCIAL_MEDIA_HANDLES: Social media profile links or handles
